SUBMITTED.label: Claim submitted
SUBMITTED.plain: We have your claim. It is now in our system and waiting for the first check.
SUBMITTED.meaning: Your claim has been registered and will be picked up by the claims team.
next_steps: Keep the original bills and reports safe
Watch for an SMS or email asking for anything else

DOCS_PENDING.label: Awaiting documents
DOCS_PENDING.plain: We need one or more documents from you before we can move forward.
DOCS_PENDING.meaning: Processing is paused until the missing documents arrive. The clock restarts when we receive them.
next_steps: Upload the requested documents through the portal or app
Make sure scans are clear and every page is included

UNDER_REVIEW.label: Under review
UNDER_REVIEW.plain: A claims specialist is checking your bills against your policy terms.
UNDER_REVIEW.meaning: We are verifying that the claim is covered and the amounts are correct. No action is needed from you right now.
next_steps: Nothing needed from you at this stage
Reply promptly if we ask for any clarification

ADJUDICATION.label: Decision in progress
ADJUDICATION.plain: The review is nearly done and a decision on your claim is being finalized.
ADJUDICATION.meaning: An adjudicator is applying your policy terms - sub-limits, deductibles and exclusions - to decide the payable amount.
next_steps: You will receive the decision letter once it is approved internally

APPROVED.label: Approved
APPROVED.plain: Good news - your claim has been approved and the settlement amount is set.
APPROVED.meaning: The payable amount has been finalized. Payment processing is the next stage.
next_steps: Check that your bank details on the portal are correct
Funds usually reach your account within the stated settlement window

PARTIALLY_APPROVED.label: Partially approved
PARTIALLY_APPROVED.plain: Your claim is approved, but only part of the amount you asked for is payable.
PARTIALLY_APPROVED.meaning: Some items were not payable under your policy - for example room-rent sub-limits, deductibles, co-pay or non-medical items. The decision letter lists each deduction.
next_steps: Read the deduction breakup in your decision letter
You may ask for a breakup review if a deduction looks wrong

REJECTED.label: Not approved
REJECTED.plain: Unfortunately this claim cannot be paid under the current policy terms.
REJECTED.meaning: The claim fell outside cover - for example outside the policy period, an excluded condition, or missing mandatory evidence. The decision letter states the exact reason.
next_steps: Read the reason in the decision letter
If you disagree, raise a grievance within 15 days with supporting evidence

PAYMENT_PROCESSING.label: Payment processing
PAYMENT_PROCESSING.plain: Your settlement has been approved and the money is on its way.
PAYMENT_PROCESSING.meaning: The payment file has been created and is queued for transfer to your registered bank account.
next_steps: Watch your bank account for the credit
If the money does not arrive in 5 working days, contact support with your claim ID

CLOSED.label: Claim closed
CLOSED.plain: This claim is fully settled and closed.
CLOSED.meaning: Payment has been made and no further action is pending on this claim.
next_steps: Download the settlement letter from the portal for your records
A new incident needs a new claim
